$comment: Scoped release definition of done, adapted from canonical toolkit template. Existing root criteria and device gates are unchanged.

features.title: Readable and honest Forge choice
features.acceptance: Forge sheet fits 320px and enlarged text through scrolling; clearly distinguishes free play and one-time endgame unlock; localised Play price, close/not-now, restore and pending-state safety verified without billing changes.

features.title: Teach existing preview and turn resolution
features.acceptance: Manual and contextual spending tip explicitly explain the existing attack/block preview and end-turn action; existing French/Spanish/Portuguese translations stay in sync; original guided-tour tests pass.
features.verify: flutter test test/release_clarity_test.dart test/interface_languages_test.dart test/tour_test.dart test/tips_test.dart

features.title: Explicit edge-to-edge and preserved optimisation
features.acceptance: Edge-to-edge mode configured at startup; manual and Forge controls respect safe insets; existing R8/resource shrinking and bounded background decode preserved. No claim of physical-device QA or resolved Play warning.

features.title: German Play listing
features.acceptance: de-DE name, short/full description saved and read back with truthful language coverage and monetisation, within Play limits, preserving real assets and other locales.
features.evidence: 2026-10-02 authenticated Play Console: de-DE added; name28/30, short73/80, full2283/4000; all three fields equal store-de-DE.json after reload; explicit no-German-gameplay disclosure; English and inherited graphic assets preserved. Publishing overview showed exactly the German Add language item, not a release. Submission/live status recorded separately in progress.

features.title: Verified signed GitHub release
features.acceptance: Unchanged full CI passes on exact release source; signed APK/AAB metadata, permanent certificate and SHA256 verified; v0.186.0 published with expected assets.
features.verify: GitHub Actions and downloaded binary verification

features.title: Production release submitted to Play
features.acceptance: Correct higher-code signed AAB and intended listing changes alone submitted; release and publishing state reloaded and recorded. Availability is never inferred from submission.
features.verify: Play Console production and publishing readback

features.title: Verified release update in appropriate existing Reddit discussion
features.acceptance: No duplicate standalone ads; release facts and availability accurate; authorised post/comment body, author and permalink read back.
